# Panduan Tugas Kelompok {.pbp-page-title}

Panduan lengkap untuk mengerjakan tugas kelompok (GitHub Organization, *pull request*, *branch* protection, CI/CD ke PWS, alat manajemen proyek, dst) untuk Semester Gasal 2026/2027 akan diunggah di halaman ini menyusul, mendekati minggu Proyek Tengah Semester.

Sementara itu, lihat halaman **Proyek Tengah Semester** dan **Proyek Akhir Semester** di menu Tugas untuk jadwal dan target tiap tahapan.

:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}

# Group Assignment Guide {.pbp-page-title}

The full guide for working on group assignments (GitHub Organization, *pull requests*, *branch* protection, CI/CD to PWS, project management tools, etc.) for Odd Semester 2026/2027 will be uploaded to this page later, closer to the Mid-Term Group Project weeks.

In the meantime, see the **Mid-Term Group Project** and **Final Group Project** pages under the Assignments menu for the schedule and target of each stage.

:::
